resume.summary-body: Senior Software Engineer at Chanwanich Company Limited (promoted April 2026), full-stack developer there since April 2024 after a 16-month internship. I build government systems for Thailand’s Eastern Economic Corridor in .NET, Next.js and Flutter: I wrote almost all of the EEC ID identity app (NFC passport reading, face match, sign-in for partner apps) and built e-Customs’ scheduling service and most of its payment service. Outside working hours I deliver freelance projects — a university journal migrated with nothing lost, an exam platform load-tested before launch — and maintain open-source developer tools; Qorstack Report renders certificates in a government e-service.
